messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: Pager — SEV2 triggered for streaming endpoint /v1/stream (us-west-2). Error spike: 13% disconnects (SSE) and ~7% malformed tool-call payloads since 08:13 UTC. Page routed to alex (oncall).

alex (oncall): on it. grabbing logs, can someone confirm customer-visible errors vs internal retries?

jordan (sre): seeing two patterns in the tail-end of requests: abrupt SSE disconnects + JSON parse errors from toolcall frames. Correlating by request_id now.

maya (eng-runtime): putting together a quick timeline. I see a surge starting 08:12:30. Runtime nodes reporting socket ECONNRESET from nginx->runtime proxied connections. Also some clients sending incomplete final chunk leading to truncated JSON in tool-call frames.

owen (eng-platform): pushed a small nginx config rollback at 08:15:02 due to a canary change earlier this morning — rolling that back might stop resets. rolling back now.

elena (pm): customer-facing impact: initial telemetry shows ~1200 affected sessions in the last 30m, mostly chat streaming and webhook toolcalls. No major enterprise tenants flagged yet but a few support tickets opened.

support-bot: Support queue #streaming shows 6 new tickets flagged "stream disconnected" and 2 flagged "tool call parse error". Links: <https://support.company/tickets/1832>, <https://support.company/tickets/1835>.

alex (oncall): thanks. Jordan + Maya: can you share a short timeline and a few sample request_ids we can attach to tickets? I'll do initial customer comms.

jordan (sre): timeline draft:
```
08:11:45 - background canary nginx change deployed to us-west-2 canary pool
08:12:30 - spike in SSE disconnects starts (ECONNRESET observed)
08:14:50 - first malformed tool-call payload logged (incomplete JSON object)
08:15:02 - platform rollback started
08:16:10 - transient drop in disconnects, but malformed payloads persist
08:18:30 - autoscale triggered on runtime pool to handle retries
08:20:05 - mitigation: increase socket timeout + 20s backlog on nginx
```
Sample request_ids: req_7a3f2b, req_7a3f77, req_7a3fb9 (shared in logs).

maya (eng-runtime): uploading trimmed logs and parser traces to S3: <https://s3.company/logs/incidents/1755554321/trace_bundle.tar.gz>. Included: kv cache traces, SSE frames, raw toolcall payloads. Example malformed fragment:
```
{"tool": "search", "args": {"q": "redwood inference"}
```
(note the missing closing brace/newline fragmentation)

owen (eng-platform): nginx rollback completed at 08:15:32. early signs of reduced ECONNRESETs. full infra metrics: <https://metrics.company/graph?range=30m&panel=conn_resets_usw2>.

elena (pm): drafting a customer note: ETA for more detail 09:00 UTC. Alex please include high-level root cause hypothesis so support can triage tickets.

alex (oncall): agree. Hypotheses I want tracked in-thread:
- Hypothesis A: Canary nginx change introduced aggressive connection handling => ECONNRESET => clients got truncated frames => parser saw partial JSON => tool-call parse errors.
- Hypothesis B: Some clients (older SDK) changed chunking semantics; runtime should handle incremental frames but parser had an edge-case.
- Hypothesis C: Upstream network flaps caused retransmits that produced interleaved frames.

jordan (sre): tests to run: replay raw frames from S3 against parser harness, confirm whether truncated frames produce the exact error. Also verify nginx config diff: <https://repo.company/ops/nginx/commits/2026-03-14-canary>.

maya (eng-runtime): running parser replay now (local harness). Quick result: truncated trailing brace leads to JSON::ParserError at the exact offset we see. Adding small patch to be more tolerant of final-chunk trimming in parser, will push as hotfix to canary if tests pass.

owen (eng-platform): also observed increased keepalive timeout due to host level TCP backlog; reverting earlier tuning fixed resets but not parsing. Looks like both platform + parser interplay.

elena (pm): customer impact breakdown request: which customers saw toolcall-level failures vs just disconnects? Support gave a list, uploading to the incident folder.

support-bot: Affected customers (anonymized): acct-17, acct-42, acct-81. Severity: sessions degraded (partial outputs) for acct-42.

alex (oncall): mitigation plan for now:
1) roll back nginx canary (done)
2) push parser hotfix tolerant-of-final-chunk to canary runtime (maya)
3) patch telemetry to emit frame-complete markers so we can count incomplete frames (owen)
4) customer comms: interim note at 08:35 UTC, update at 09:00 UTC (elena)

maya (eng-runtime): hotfix pushed to 10% canary at 08:27 UTC. Parser patch tolerates trailing newline/fragment and queues a re-request for missing tail tokens. Canary logs: reduced JSON::ParserError count by ~85% in canary nodes.

jordan (sre): running a broader replay against production traces now. If canary holds for 10m, promote fix.

owen (eng-platform): adding a short-term nginx socket timeout bump and enabling proxy buffer flush to reduce mid-chunk cuts: applied at 08:33 UTC. Monitoring.

elena (pm): ETA update: canary shows improvements, preparing customer message: "We've deployed a fix to tolerate truncated frames and reverted a recent config change. Some sessions previously affected should now resume streaming; we're continuing to monitor." Alex will send.

alex (oncall): sent interim comms at 08:39 UTC. Keep monitoring; add any fresh request_ids here.

jordan (sre): promoting parser fix to 100% at 08:46 UTC after 15m stable canary and low error counts.

maya (eng-runtime): promoted. Post-promotion metrics: parser errors down 92%, SSE disconnects down to baseline over next 10m.

elena (pm): support to follow up with affected customers and escalate if any regressions. Good work.

alex (oncall): final notes and followups for RCA doc:
- Root cause: combination of a morning nginx canary change that increased mid-chunk socket resets + parser edge-case that failed on truncated final frames.
- Immediate mitigation: nginx rollback + parser tolerance hotfix + minor socket tuning.
- Action items:
  * ops: add canary rollout checklist for nginx changes (owen)
  * runtime: add unit tests for incremental-frame parsing + telemetry for frame-complete markers (maya)
  * support: send customer closure note when we confirm full recovery (elena/support-bot)

support-bot: Closing loop: created postmortem draft at <https://docs.company/incidents/1755554321-postmortem>. Please add logs and ownership.

alex (oncall): marked incident as mitigated at 08:59 UTC. Will lead RCA doc. Thanks all. :heart:
